beginner_version.found: Tiny separate things: yes, dozens of thin far trunks, a web of twigs, single yellow leaves. Textures of hundreds of items: yes, the leaf litter across the bottom third and the twig-and-leaf canopy across the top third. Detail inside big shapes: yes, carved birch bark. More parts than 8 at different distances: yes, many layers of trees. busy measured 66% fine texture.
beginner_version.list: keep only six big near birches and about five pale far trunks; drop all other thin trunks and the twig web across the top third; canopy across the top third becomes loose gold dabs; far forest one blue-gray haze with a soft blue-green conifer mass on the right; ground across the bottom third becomes loose orange-gold and brown dabs; path a soft lighter band; rock one gray-green shape; bark simple dark dashes and a shaded side; keep the low sun at upper left with soft rays
beginner_version.why: The photo is far past the beginner detail budget: every step is cut from the finish, so every twig and leaf would have to be painted by some step.

canvas_fit.lost: nothing; a strip of canopy at the top and leaf-covered ground at the bottom were painted on by the extend render
canvas_fit.why: No canvas was named, so fit-canvas picked the standard size closest to the 3:2 photo (12 x 16). Cropping to 4:3 would have cut into the near birch trunks at both edges, which frame the path, so it extended the picture with one render instead.

photo_prep.subject: an autumn birch grove: white birch trunks framing a leaf-covered path that winds back into misty blue forest, low sun glowing in from the upper left, yellow leaves on the branches and the ground
photo_prep.why: nothing in the image is outside the scene: no bars, captions, border, or watermark
